messages:
liam_sales: Heads-up: Onyx Financial wants `onyx-8b-open` pinned in US (us-west) + EU (ams). They also asked if we can support a 3-bit quant profile for cost reasons and want a phased canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%). Pricing expectation: 40% reduction vs standard hosted. Any immediate no-gos? :money_with_wings:
sara_product: Thanks Liam. A few quick clarifiers: 1) steady qps / burst? 2) 95th or p99 target? 3) do they require Dedicated on day 1?
liam_sales: They're low-latency chat use: steady ~8 qps, burst 40 qps. Target p95 <= 220ms. Prefer Hosted pinned routing but will pay for Dedicated if isolation is required. Canary timeline: 2-week phasing.
raj_infra: Technical note: we have no validated 3-bit quant artifacts for onyx-8b. 3-bit (ternary-like) quant can reduce memory but often needs custom kernels and thorough regression tests. Risk: more generation divergence. For their p95 target at 8qps, hosted pinned on A100-80s should be fine with 4-bit; 3-bit may require additional infra tuning.
ela_legal: Also check license and export controls before replication to EU. Ask customer to provide artifact + license. If customer wants us to produce the quantized artifact on their data, need MSA annex for IP.
devex_bot: Intake form created: https://redwood.atlassian.com/INTAKE-5972  Please attach model weights, license, and sample prompts.
onboard_bot: Onboard ticket ONB-4410 created. Priority: P2. Owner: unassigned. Tags: customer-driven, geo-pin, canary.
sara_product: Proposed acceptance criteria to move to backlog: - artifact + license uploaded and cleared by Legal - perf staging: p95 <= 220ms at steady 8qps (canary config applied) - quant artifact validated (if customer insists on 3-bit, must pass our regression suite) - canary rollout plan and automatic rollback on quality regressions - pricing and billing tier agreed
liam_sales: Customer is pushing for 3-bit to hit cost target. They can sign a co-dev clause if we need to produce quant artifacts.
raj_infra: If we agree to 3-bit co-dev, estimate 4-7 infra/dev days for quant pipeline, kernel work, and validation. If they accept 4-bit, we can likely do pilot in 10 business days. Also need regional KMS provisioning for EU.
ela_legal: I'll review license once attached. Co-dev clause ok but need to scope IP and support SLAs.
sara_product: OK. I'll add to backlog under "model-onboards/customer-pinning" and mark customer-driven + needs-legal. Assign owner before next roadmap sync. @raj_infra can you post a rough effort estimate in INTK-5972 by EOD?
raj_infra: Will do 44d. I'll include a best/worst-case ETA and note kernel risk for 3-bit.
liam_sales: Onyx Financial wants a pilot in US within 3 weeks if possible. They can provide prompts and will prioritize the co-dev budget if we need it.
sara_product: Great. I'll take product ownership for the rollout. We'll wait for the artifact and license from the customer then proceed with the intake ticket.
